author: DUYTRUYENTHONG
privacy: Anonymous application references only; no candidate contacts, employer identities, private URLs, recruiter messages, receipts or workspace paths.
count_scope: Observed employer confirmations or observed email sending under the candidate-approved original/adjacent/stretch scope. Not 100 offers and not a certified 100-best-fit cohort.
provenance: Maintainer summary from the existing private canonical ledger and an authenticated two-mailbox review including Spam. Raw evidence stays private; public readers cannot independently audit it.
measurement_limits: Host-assisted campaign; not a replay of the portable kit end-to-end
Sending does not guarantee employer inbox delivery
Snapshot, not a live inbox monitor
No response found is not an employer rejection
